WITH subReplyData AS ( SELECT pcsr.cm_reply_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'cmSuplyId', pcsr.cm_suply_id, 'mbId', pcsr.mb_id, 'contents', pcsr.contents, 'createYmd', DATE_FORMAT(pcsr.create_ymd, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'createId', pcsr.create_id, 'mbNick', gm.mb_nick ) ) AS sub_reply_list FROM pet_cm_sub_reply pcsr INNER JOIN g5_member gm ON pcsr.mb_id = gm.mb_id WHERE pcsr.del_fl = 0 GROUP BY pcsr.cm_reply_id ),
ReplyData AS ( SELECT pcr.cm_board_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'cmReplyId', pcr.cm_reply_id, 'mbId', pcr.mb_id, 'contents', pcr.contents, 'subReplyList', sRd.sub_reply_list, 'createYmd', DATE_FORMAT(pcr.create_ymd, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'createId', pcr.create_id, 'mbNick', gm.mb_nick ) ) AS reply_list FROM pet_cm_reply pcr INNER JOIN g5_member gm ON pcr.mb_id = gm.mb_id LEFT JOIN subReplyData sRd ON pcr.cm_reply_id = sRd.cm_reply_id GROUP BY pcr.cm_board_id ),
imageData AS ( SELECT cm_board_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'cmFmapId', cm_fmap_id, 'imageUrl', bf_fileurl, 'fileName', bf_source ) ) AS image_list FROM ( SELECT pcfm.cm_board_id, pcfm.cm_fmap_id, g5bf.bf_fileurl, g5bf.bf_source FROM pet_cm_file_mapping pcfm LEFT JOIN g5_board_file g5bf ON pcfm.cm_fmap_id = g5bf.wr_id AND g5bf.bo_table = 'pet_cm_board' ORDER BY g5bf.bf_datetime DESC ) AS sorted GROUP BY cm_board_id ),
likeUserData AS ( SELECT pclm.cm_board_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('mbId', pclm.mb_id)) AS like_user_list FROM pet_cm_like_mapping pclm WHERE pclm.del_fl = 0 GROUP BY pclm.cm_board_id ),
boardData AS ( SELECT pcb.*, gm.mb_nick, gbf.bf_fileurl, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pcb.create_ymd DESC) AS row_num, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet_cm_like_mapping WHERE del_fl = 0 AND cm_board_id = pcb.cm_board_id) AS like_cnt FROM pet_cm_board pcb INNER JOIN g5_member gm ON pcb.mb_id = gm.mb_id LEFT JOIN g5_board_file gbf ON gbf.bo_table = 'user_profile' AND gm.mb_no = gbf.wr_id AND pcb.del_fl = 0 )
SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS bd.row_num, bd.cm_board_id, bd.mb_id, bd.subject, bd.contents,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pet_cm_like_mapping WHERE cm_board_id = bd.cm_board_id AND mb_id = #{mbId} AND del_fl = 0 ) AS is_liked,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet_cm_like_mapping WHERE cm_board_id = bd.cm_board_id AND del_fl = 0) AS like_cnt,
lud.like_user_list,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pet_cm_bookmark WHERE cm_board_id = bd.cm_board_id AND mb_id = #{mbId} AND del_fl = 0 ) AS is_book_marked,
bd.create_ymd, bd.create_id, rd.reply_list, id.image_list, bd.mb_nick, bd.cm_type, bd.bf_fileurl AS user_profile_url FROM boardData bd LEFT JOIN ReplyData rd ON bd.cm_board_id = rd.cm_board_id LEFT JOIN imageData id ON bd.cm_board_id = id.cm_board_id LEFT JOIN likeUserData lud ON bd.cm_board_id = lud.cm_board_id WHERE bd.del_fl = 0
AND bd.mb_id = #{mbId}
AND lud.like_user_list LIKE CONCAT('%', #{mbId}, '%')
ORDER BY bd.like_cnt DESC, bd.row_num ASC
LIMIT #{pageNo}, #{pageSize};
